$Comment: What the Horseman's Hoard on the hard ride (Rewards/Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase_Hard),
which players see as his Boss Kill Claim on the hard ride, pays for the first hard win each day.
Every roll is read on its own: the first has no Chance, so it always pays two Spectral Lantern
Bombs and the Hoard is never empty; the next always pays 1 to 4 Grave Candles (Count to CountMax,
drawn evenly), for the normal graveyard or ten at a time for a Burning Grave Candle at Old Jack's
shop (Hallows_Eve_Offer_Burning_Grave_Candle_Trade.json); then the plain pieces of his armour (the
Horseman's Breastplate, Gauntlets, Greaves and Helm) at better odds than the normal Hoard's; then
the Horseman's flaming breastplate, which pays from here and nowhere else; then the rest of the
Flaming Hallowed set's pieces (the Burning Jack Helm, his flaming gauntlets, greaves and helm, and
the Flaming Jack Shield) at three times the normal Hoard's odds; then the Eternal Candle
(Item/Items/Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Eternal_Candle.json), which opens his normal graveyard without
burning a Grave Candle and is never used up, and pays from here and nowhere else; then the
Horseman's Steed Trophy, a tiny figure of his horse to place as a block, on every server, at three
times the normal Hoard's odds; the last always pays the Hallowed's favor (the normal Hoard pays Old
Jack's instead). The Hoard is not scaled by each player's share of the fight, so everyone who
fought him rolls these odds. Mmo_Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase_Hard.json adds Defense XP where MMO
Skill Tree runs, and Hallows_Eve_Horsemans_Reins_Chase_Hard.json the Horseman's Reins where Alec's
Tamework runs. The graveyard's
tombstone and ruins lantern pay only from the normal Hoard, Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json beside
this file, and the Almanac's Hoard grid (ZiggfreedCommon/Almanac/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve.json)
lists what both pay, so change them together. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100.
Name: Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase_Hard
